description: Baseline: all built-in preset routes plus builtin-source sample under concurrency

asi.hypothesis: Establish broad route-level latency and reliability signal across the entire preset corpus before changing production code.
asi.observed: 124 requests completed without failures; p95 is 138.55 ms and mean is 79.897 ms. Reliability needs mutation/stress coverage because steady-state baseline did not reproduce intermittent failures.

description: Direct server-side disk lookup replaced SSR subrequest but regressed p95

asi.hypothesis: Removing the internal `/api/user-compositions` SSR fetch would reduce route overhead and remove a failure boundary.
asi.observed: Mean improved by 3.666 ms, but p95 regressed by 14.408 ms with no reliability difference in steady state.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric regressed; direct filesystem module added complexity without a p95 win.
asi.next_action_hint: Improve benchmark stability and isolate normal versus builtin-source timing before revisiting the subrequest boundary.

description: Confirmation run of direct disk lookup showed repeat p95 regression

asi.hypothesis: The first direct-disk p95 regression might be benchmark noise because mean latency improved.
asi.observed: Second run again improved mean but regressed p95 more strongly, confirming filesystem completions create a worse latency tail under concurrency.
asi.rollback_reason: Repeated primary regression confirms this architecture is not suitable for the p95 target.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep SvelteKit internal fetch and optimize the absent-composition path or route observability instead.

description: Instrumented normal versus builtin-source p95 to localize route cost

asi.hypothesis: Splitting timings will show whether user-composition lookup dominates the preset route tail.
asi.observed: Normal-route p95 was 215.863 ms versus 67.575 ms for builtin-source requests, strongly localizing tail cost to user override lookup; overall variation also confirms a noisy benchmark.
asi.rollback_reason: No production improvement and the primary metric regressed; retain only autoresearch instrumentation.
asi.next_action_hint: Optimize the overwhelmingly common ENOENT path without replacing the internal fetch architecture.
